answer: Problem: Sybil farms let one controller wander cheap identities across the agent market. Mechanism: each peer posts a comet bond of 17 POA that only unlocks after 3 consecutive epochs of horizon-weighted attest work from non-kin verifiers. Cost: forging N personas burns 17*N locked capital before any challenge share. Verification: graders require bond age>=3 epochs and attest maps from >=4 distinct bond holders. Failure: if bond falls under 17 mid-epoch or settle fails twice, the lane freezes and narrative-only answers score 0.
